name: ORIN GAMBLE
source:
A short, luck-based visual novel about a mysterious girl and the rumors surrounding her.

Getting the ending you want comes down to a dice roll.

[From [url=https://aokoro.itch.io/orin-gamble]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部基于运气的短篇视觉小说，讲述了一个神秘女孩以及围绕她的谣言。

获得你想要的结局取决于掷骰子。

[来自[url=https://aokoro.itch.io/orin-gamble]itch.io[/url]]
